sentence: This project builds imaging reagents and microscopy tools to study how engineered immune cells recognize and destroy cancer cells.
This project develops measures of behavior in online alcohol use disorder recovery forums and tests a behavioral intervention in a pilot randomized clinical trial.
This project designs inhibitors of the β-lactamases in Carbapenem-Resistant Acinetobacter baumannii and studies how these inhibitors can get into the cell better.
This project studies how the cytoskeleton is controlled during cell division in the model organism Caenorhabditis elegans, using molecular genetics and microscopy.
This project focuses on genetics and genomics, fields that contribute to essentially all medical applications.
This project builds computational and in vitro flow models of the fetal aorta to improve how accurately coarctation of the aorta is diagnosed in fetuses.
This project studies how sex differences in two types of immune cells, macrophages and eosinophils, affect obesity and type 2 immunity.
This project tests whether two drugs can strengthen T cell attacks on tumor cells and improve the effect of several immunotherapy treatments.
This project studies a treatment using physical and chemical stimuli to wake the body's own skeletal stem cells to regenerate cartilage lost with osteoarthritis.
This project combines experiment, computation and chemical synthesis to find small molecules that target RNA, including bacterial ribonuclease P.
This project tests whether DNA sequence changes alter gene control in cell types of pancreatic islets and add to type 2 diabetes risk.
This project builds tools that identify and measure biological macromolecules to help explain normal biology and disease.
This project looks at the ethical, legal and social challenges raised by genomic technologies.
This project combines medical imaging, a robotic catheter and visualization tools to improve Left Atrial Appendage Occlusion procedures for stroke prevention in atrial fibrillation.
This project studies which cell and molecular mechanisms cause vascular calcification in chronic kidney disease.
This project offers disease modeling, animal imaging and preclinical testing services that support cancer research.
This project studies enzymes that remodel chromosome structure and how they control gene expression, DNA repair and DNA copying during cell division.
This project studies how altered blood flow from a diseased heart valve changes the atria and ventricles and makes an irregular rhythm more likely.
This project uses bovine blastoids, which are blastocyst-like structures, to study the early stages of human development before implantation.
This project builds a hardware system that measures brain electrical signals and functional MRI signals at the same time as transcranial magnetic stimulation.
